title: dotcontext marketplace manifest
description: Catalog of Layer 2 items installable via the dotcontext TUI.

version.description: Manifest schema version (independent of CLI version).

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Used as lockfile key.

category.description: Display group in the TUI Browse tab.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the TUI.

description.description: Single-line description shown in the TUI list.

long_description.description: Multi-line description shown in the detail pane.

starter_pack.description: If true, included when the user clicks 'Install starter pack'.

default_scope.description: Scope used if the user doesn't toggle. Must be in scopes_supported.

depends_on.description: Item ids that must be installed alongside this one (resolved transitively).

files.description: For command-bundle / skill / hook / script: source paths in the repo and destination paths under scope root.

mcp_key.description: For type=mcp: optional override for the key used under mcpServers in settings.json. Defaults to item id.

mcp_config.description: For type=mcp: entry merged into .mcp.json (local) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global) under mcpServers.<mcp_key|id>.

auth_required.description: For mcp / external-cli: TUI Status tab warns if auth not yet completed.

verify_command.description: For external-cli: command to confirm the binary works post-install (e.g., 'gh --version').

auth_command.description: For external-cli: command to check auth state (e.g., 'gh auth status').

settings_keys.description: For mcp / hook items: dotted JSON paths in settings.json owned by this item. Used by uninstall.

hook_config.description: For type=hook: hook entry to merge into settings.json.
